_note: Approvals for the automatic import after a deploy (what a person would tick on the Import screen). Every warning class needs a reason; every large change needs its record ID in large; missing records need a decision in missing (ID: removed_from_game, draft or ignore).

warnings.community_required: Seed data from the community Fandom wiki (owner decision 2026-10-23: wiki data, no in-game checks asked of Ali). Values show 'Source: community wiki'; pages index only once they have our own reviewed note.
warnings.meta_missing: The wiki gives no reliable update schedule (and for GAG2 no clear release date), so the hub leaves those facts out.
warnings.meta_provenance: calc_defaults is our own editorial choice, not a game fact.
warnings.outlier: Event, pack and limited crops sit far above or below shop crops of the same rarity; values match the wiki crop data module.
warnings.rarity_order: Crop rarity in this game does not track sell value closely (event and limited crops); values match the wiki crop data module.
